Title: PluginServer Model
Summary: Model representing a plugin distribution server configuration.
Content:
# PluginServer Model

## Namespace
`Cyrena.Extensa.Models`

## Purpose
Represents a plugin distribution server that end users can add and manage.

## Properties

### Id (required)
```csharp
public required string Id { get; set; }
```
Unique identifier for the server. Auto-generated if not provided.

### Name (required)
```csharp
public required string Name { get; set; }
```
Display name shown to users.

### BaseUrl (required)
```csharp
public required Uri BaseUrl { get; set; }
```
Base URL of the plugin server (e.g., "https://plugins.example.com/").

### ApplicationId
```csharp
public string? ApplicationId { get; set; }
```
Optional application ID for this server.

### IsEnabled
```csharp
public bool IsEnabled { get; set; } = true;
```
Whether the server is active. Disabled servers are excluded from queries.

### Priority
```csharp
public int Priority { get; set; }
```
Ordering priority (lower = higher priority).

### AddedAt
```csharp
public DateTimeOffset AddedAt { get; set; } = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow;
```
When the server was added.

## Example

```csharp
var server = new PluginServer
{
    Id = "custom-plugins",
    Name = "Community Plugins",
    BaseUrl = new Uri("https://community.example.com/"),
    ApplicationId = "my-app",
    IsEnabled = true,
    Priority = 10
};
```

## See Also
- `IPluginServerService` for managing servers
- `PluginQueryOptions` for filtering packages
